name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Strength: Kitsune are agile and companionable, but tend to be physically weak.

name: Kitsune
text: Kitsune are humanoids with the kitsune and shapechanger subtypes.

name: Medium
text: Kitsune are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Kitsune have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: Kitsune can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

name: Change Shape
text: A kitsune can assume the appearance of a specific single human form of the same sex. The kitsune always takes this specific form when she uses this ability. A kitsune in human form cannot use her bite attack, but gains a +10 racial bonus on Disguise checks made to appear human. Changing shape is a standard action. This ability otherwise functions as alter self, except that the kitsune does not adjust her ability scores and can remain in this form indefinitely.

name: Agile
text: Kitsune receive a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks.

name: Kitsune Magic
text: Kitsune add 1 to the DCs of any saving throws to resist enchantment spells that they cast. Kitsune with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like ability: 3/day—dancing lights (caster level equals the kitsune’s level).

name: Natural Weapons
text: In her natural form, a kitsune has a bite attack that deals 1d4 points of damage.

name: Languages
text: Kitsune begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Kitsune with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human language, Aklo, Celestial, Elven, Gnome, and Tengu.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma: Aasimars are insightful, confident, and personable. Aasimars of specific bloodlines (see below) gain different ability score modifiers as indicated.

name: Native Outsider
text: Aasimars are outsiders with the native subtype.

name: Medium
text: Aasimars are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Aasimars have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Aasimars can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Skilled
text: Aasimars have a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Perception checks. Aasimars of specific bloodlines (see below) gain a +2 bonus on different skill checks as indicated.

name: Spell-Like Ability
text: Aasimars can use daylight once per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the aasimar’s character level). Aasimars of specific bloodlines (see below) gain other spell-like abilities in place of daylight.

name: Celestial Resistance
text: Aasimars have acid resistance 5, cold resistance 5, and electricity resistance 5.

name: Languages
text: Aasimars begin play speaking Common and Celestial. Aasimars with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Sylvan.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Wisdom: Catfolk are sociable and agile, but often lack common sense.

name: Catfolk
text: Catfolk are humanoids with the catfolk subtype.

name: Medium
text: Catfolk are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Catfolk have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: In dim light, catfolk can see twice as far as humans.

name: Cat’s Luck
text: Once per day when a catfolk attempts a Reflex saving throw, he can roll the saving throw twice and take the better result. He must decide to use this ability before the saving throw is attempted.

name: Natural Hunter
text: Catfolk receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception, Stealth, and Survival checks.

name: Sprinter
text: Catfolk gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions.

name: Languages
text: Catfolk begin play speaking Common and Catfolk. Catfolk with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Sylvan.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma, –2 Constitution: Changelings are frail, but are clever and comely.

name: Medium
text: Changelings are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Humanoid
text: Changelings are humanoids with the changeling subtype.

name: Normal Speed
text: Changelings have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Hag Racial Trait
text: Each changeling inherits one of the following racial traits, depending on her mother’s hag type. (As outsiders, night hags produce half-fiend children, not changelings.)

name: Claws
text: Changelings’ fingernails are hard and sharp, granting them two claw attacks (1d4 points of damage each).

name: Natural Armor
text: Changelings have a +1 natural armor bonus.

name: Darkvision
text: Changelings can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Languages
text: Changelings begin play speaking Common and the primary language of their host societies. Changelings with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, and Orc.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Constitution: Dhampirs are fast and seductive, but their mortal vigor is impeded. Dhampirs of specific heritages (see below) gain different ability score modifiers as indicated.

name: Dhampir
text: Dhampirs are humanoids with the dhampir subtype.

name: Medium
text: Dhampirs are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Dhampirs have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Senses
text: Dhampirs get low-light vision and darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

name: Manipulative
text: Dhampirs gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Perception checks. Dhampirs of specific heritages (see below) gain a +2 bonus on different skill checks as indicated.

name: Undead Resistance
text: Dhampirs gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against disease and mind-affecting effects.

name: Light Sensitivity
text: Dhampirs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell. Dhampirs of specific heritages (see below) gain different weaknesses.

name: Negative Energy Affinity
text: Though they’re living creatures, dhampirs react to positive and negative energy as if they were undead; positive energy harms them, and negative energy heals them.

name: Spell-Like Ability
text: A dhampir can use detect undead three times per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the dhampir’s character level). Dhampirs of specific heritages (see below) gain other spell-like abilities in place of detect undead.

name: Resist Level Drain
text: A dhampir takes no penalties from energy drain effects, though he can still be killed if he accrues more negative levels then he has Hit Dice. After 24 hours, any negative levels a dhampir takes are removed without the need for an additional saving throw.

name: Languages
text: Dhampirs begin play speaking Common. Dhampirs with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except secret languages, such as Druidic).

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Constitution: Drow are nimble and manipulative.

name: Elf
text: Drow are humanoids with the elf subtype.

name: Medium
text: Drow are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Drow have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Drow can see in the dark up to 120 feet.

name: Drow Immunities
text: Drow are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.

name: Keen Senses
text: Drow gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

name: Poison Use
text: Drow are skilled in the use of poison and never risk accidentally poisoning themselves.

name: Spell Resistance
text: A drow possesses an amount of spell resistance equal to 6 + her character level.

name: Spell-Like Abilities
text: A drow can cast dancing lights, darkness, and faerie fire, each once per day, using her total character level as her caster level.

name: Light Blindness
text: Abrupt exposure to bright light blinds drow for 1 round; on subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the affected area.

name: Weapon Familiarity
text: Drow are proficient with the hand crossbow, rapier, and short sword.

name: Languages
text: Drow begin play speaking Elven and Undercommon. Drow with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Abyssal, Aklo, Aquan, Common, Draconic, Gnome, Goblin, and Sakvroth.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, –4 Charisma: Duergar are hearty and observant, but also belligerent.

name: Medium
text: Duergar are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Dwarf
text: Duergar are humanoids with the dwarf subtype.

name: Slow and Steady
text: Duergar have a base speed of 20 feet, but their speed is never modified by armor or encumbrance.

name: Superior Darkvision
text: Duergar can see in the dark up to 120 feet.

name: Duergar Immunities
text: Duergar are immune to paralysis, phantasms, and poison. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against spells and spell-like abilities.

name: Stability
text: Duergar receive a +4 racial bonus to their Combat Maneuver Defense against bull rush or trip attempts while standing on the ground.

name: Spell-Like Abilities
text: A duergar can use enlarge person and invisibility each once per day, using her character level as her caster level and affecting itself only.

name: Light Sensitivity
text: Duergar are dazzled in areas of bright light.

name: Languages
text: Duergar begin play speaking Common, Dwarven, and Undercommon. Duergar with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Draconic, Giant, Goblin, Orc, and Terran.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Wisdom: Fetchlings are quick and forceful, but often strange and easily distracted by errant thoughts.

name: Native Outsider
text: Fetchlings are outsiders with the native subtype.

name: Medium
text: Fetchlings are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Fetchlings have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Fetchlings can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: Fetchlings can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

name: Skilled
text: Fetchlings have a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (planes) and Stealth checks.

name: Shadow Blending
text: Attacks against a fetchling in dim light have a 50% miss chance instead of the normal 20% miss chance. This ability does not grant total concealment; it just increases the miss chance.

name: Shadowy Resistance
text: Fetchlings have cold resistance 5 and electricity resistance 5.

name: Spell-Like Abilities
text: A fetchling can use disguise self once per day as a spell-like ability. He can assume the form of any humanoid creature using this spell-like ability. When a fetchling reaches character 9th level in any combination of classes, he gains shadow walk (self only) as a spell-like ability usable once per day, and at 13th level, he gains plane shift (self only, to the Shadow Plane or the Material Plane only) usable once per day. A fetchling’s caster level for these abilities is equal to his character level.

name: Languages
text: Fetchlings begin play speaking Common. Fetchlings with a high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Aquan, Auran, Draconic, D’ziriak (understanding only, cannot speak), Ignan, Terran, and any regional human tongue.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, –2 Wisdom: Gillmen are vigorous and beautiful, but their domination by the aboleths has made them weak-willed.

name: Medium
text: Gillmen are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Aquatic
text: Gillmen are humanoids with the aquatic subtype.

name: Normal Speed
text: Gillmen have a base speed of 30 feet on land. As aquatic creatures, they also have a swim speed of 30 feet, can move in water without making Swim checks, and always treat Swim as a class skill.

name: Amphibious
text: Gillmen have the aquatic subtype, but can breathe both water and air.

name: Enchantment Resistance
text: Gillmen gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against non-aboleth enchantment spells and effects, but take a –2 penalty on such saving throws against aboleth sources.

name: Water Dependent
text: A gillman's body requires constant submersion in fresh or salt water. Gillmen who spend more than 1 day without fully submerging themselves in water risk internal organ failure, painful cracking of the skin, and death within 4d6 hours.

name: Languages
text: Gillmen begin play speaking Common and Aboleth. Gillmen with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Aklo, Aquan, Draconic, and Elven.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +4 Dexterity, –2 Strength, –2 Charisma: Goblins are fast but weak, and they’re unpleasant to be around.

name: Goblinoid
text: Goblins are humanoids with the goblinoid subtype.

name: Small
text: Goblins are Small and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

name: Normal Speed
text: Goblins are fast for their size, and have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Goblins can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Skilled
text: +4 racial bonus on Ride and Stealth checks.

name: Languages
text: Goblins begin play speaking Goblin. Goblins with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnoll, Gnome, Halfling, and Orc.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Strength: Gripplis are nimble and alert, but spindly.

name: Small
text: Gripplis are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls,a –1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

name: Grippli
text: Gripplis are humanoids with the grippli subtype.

name: Normal Speed
text: Gripplis have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Natural Climber
text: Gripplis have a climb speed of 20 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Gripplis can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Camouflage
text: Gripplis receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks in marshes and forested areas.

name: Swamp Stride
text: A grippli can move through difficult terrain at its normal speed while within a swamp. Magically altered terrain affects a grippli normally.

name: Weapon Familiarity
text: Gripplis are proficient with nets.

name: Languages
text: Gripplis begin play speaking Common and Grippli. Gripplis with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Boggard, Draconic, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Sylvan.

name: Ability Score Modifiers

text: Hobgoblins are humanoids with the goblinoid subtype.

name: Normal Speed
text: Hobgoblins have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Hobgoblins can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Sneaky
text: Hobgoblins receive a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

name: Languages
text: Hobgoblins begin play speaking Common and Goblin. Hobgoblins with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Infernal, Giant, and Orc.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Wisdom: Ifrits are passionate and quick, but also impetuous and destructive.

text: Ifrits are outsiders with the native subtype.

text: Ifrits have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Ifrits can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Spell-Like Ability
text: Ifrits can use burning hands 1/day as a spell-like ability (caster level equals the ifrit’s character level; DC 11 + Charisma modifier).

name: Energy Resistance
text: Ifrits have fire resistance 5.

name: Fire Affinity
text: Ifrit sorcerers with the elemental (fire) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Ifrit spellcasters with the Fire domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

name: Languages
text: Ifrits begin play speaking Common and Ignan. Ifrits with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aquan, Auran, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, and Terran.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, –4 Strength, –2 Constitution: Kobolds are fast but weak.

name: Reptilian
text: Kobolds are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.

name: Small
text: Kobolds are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

name: Normal Speed
text: Kobolds have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Kobolds can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Armor
text: Kobolds have a +1 natural armor bonus.

name: Crafty
text: Kobolds gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (traps), Perception, and Profession (miner) checks. Craft (traps) and Stealth are always class skills for a kobold.

name: Light Sensitivity
text: Kobolds are dazzled as long as they remain in an area of bright light.

name: Languages
text: Kobolds begin play speaking Draconic. Kobolds with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Common, Dwarven, Gnome, and Undercommon.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, –2 Intelligence: Nagaji are strong and have forceful personalities, but they tend to ignore logic and mock scholarly pursuits.

name: Medium
text: Nagaji are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Reptilian
text: Nagaji are humanoids with the reptilian subtype.

name: Normal Speed
text: Nagaji have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: Nagaji can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

name: Armored Scales
text: Nagaji have a +1 natural armor bonus because of their scaly flesh.

name: Resistant
text: Nagaji receive a +2 racial saving throw bonus against mind-affecting effects and poison.

name: Serpent’s Sense
text: Nagaji receive a +2 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks against reptiles, and a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

name: Languages
text: Nagaji begin play speaking Common and Nagaji. Nagaji with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human tongue, Abyssal, Aklo, Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Infernal, and Sylvan.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +4 Strength, –2 Intelligence, –2 Wisdom, –2 Charisma: Orcs are brutal and savage.

name: Orc
text: Orcs are humanoids with the orc subtype.

name: Medium
text: Orcs are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Orcs have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Orcs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Light Sensitivity
text: Orcs are dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or within the radius of a daylight spell.

name: Ferocity
text: Orcs can remain conscious and continue fighting even if their hit point totals fall below 0. Orcs are still staggered at 0 hit points or lower and lose 1 hit point each round as normal.

name: Weapon Familiarity
text: Orcs are always proficient with greataxes and falchions, and treat any weapon with the word “orc” in its name as a martial weapon.

name: Languages
text: Orcs begin play speaking Common and Orc. Orcs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Dwarven, Giant, Gnoll, Goblin, and Undercommon.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, –2 Charisma: Oreads are strong, solid, stable, and stoic.

name: Native Outsider
text: Oreads are outsiders with the native subtype.

name: Medium
text: Oreads are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Slow Speed
text: Oreads have a base speed of 20 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Oreads can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Spell-Like Ability
text: Oreads can use magic stone 1/day as spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the oread’s character level; DC 11 + Charisma modifier).

name: Energy Resistance
text: Oreads have acid resistance 5.

name: Earth Affinity
text: Oread sorcerers with the elemental (earth) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Oread clerics with the Earth domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

name: Languages
text: Oreads begin play speaking Common and Terran. Oreads with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aquan, Auran, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, Ignan, and Undercommon

name: Ability Score Modifiers

text: Ratfolk are humanoids with the ratfolk subtype.

name: Slow Speed
text: Ratfolk have a base speed of 20 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Ratfolk can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Rodent Empathy
text: Ratfolk gain a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks made to influence rodents.

name: Swarming
text: Ratfolk are used to living and fighting communally, and are adept at swarming foes for their own gain and their foes’ detriment. Up to two ratfolk can share the same square at the same time. If two ratfolk in the same square attack the same foe, they are considered to be flanking that foe as if they were in two opposite squares.

name: Tinker
text: Ratfolk gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy), Perception, and Use Magic Device checks.

name: Languages
text: Ratfolk begin play speaking Common. Ratfolk with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Draconic, Dwarven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Orc, and Undercommon.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Intelligence, +2 Wisdom, –2 Constitution: Samsarans are insightful and strong-minded, but with frail bodies.

name: Samsaran
text: Samsarans are humanoids with the samsaran subtype.

name: Medium
text: Samsarans are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Samsarans have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: Samsarans can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

name: Lifebound
text: Samsarans gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws to resist death effects, saving throws against negative energy effects, Fortitude saves to remove negative levels, and Constitution checks to stabilize if reduced to negative hit points.

name: Samsaran Magic
text: Samsarans with a Charisma score of 11 or higher gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day— comprehend languages, deathwatch, and stabilize. The caster level for these effects equals the samsaran’s character level.

name: Shards of the Past
text: A samsaran’s past lives grant her bonuses on two skills. The samsaran chooses two skills—she gains a +2 racial bonus on both, and they are always class skills for her. Once made, this choice can’t be altered.

name: Languages
text: Samsarans begin play speaking Common and Samsaran. Samsarans with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human language, Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Draconic, Giant, Ignan, Infernal, Nagaji, Tengu, and Terran.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, –2 Charisma: Strix are swift and elusive, but tend to be stubborn and swift to anger.

name: Medium
text: Strix are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Strix have a base speed of 30 feet on land. They also have a fly speed of 60 feet (average).

name: Low-Light Vision
text: Strix can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

name: Darkvision
text: Strix can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Hatred
text: Strix receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the human subtype because of their special training against these hated foes.

name: Nocturnal
text: Strix gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

name: Suspicious
text: Strix receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusion spells or effects.

name: Languages
text: Strix begin play speaking Strix. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose any of the following languages: Auran, Azlanti, Common, Draconic, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, and Infernal.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma, –2 Intelligence: Sulis are brawny and charming, but slow-witted.

name: Native Outsider
text: Sulis are outsiders with the native subtype.

name: Medium
text: Sulis are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Sulis have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: Sulis can see twice as far as humans in dim light.

name: Negotiator
text: Sulis are keen negotiators, and gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.

name: Elemental Assault
text: Once per day as a swift action, a suli can shroud her arms in acid, cold, electricity, or fire. This effect lasts for 1 round per level and can be dismissed as a free action. Unarmed strikes with her arms or hands (or attacks with weapons held in those hands) deal +1d6 points of damage of the appropriate energy type.

name: Energy Resistance
text: Sulis have resistance to acid 5, cold 5, electricity 5, and fire 5.

name: Languages
text: Sulis begin play speaking Common and one elemental language (Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran). Sulis with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aquan, Auran, Draconic, Ignan, and Terran.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Strength, –4 Charisma: Svirfneblin are fast and observant but relatively weak and emotionally distant.

name: Gnome
text: Svirfneblin are humanoids with the gnome subtype.

name: Small
text: Svirfneblin are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

name: Slow Speed
text: Svirfneblin have a base speed of 20 feet.

name: Defensive Training
text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 dodge bonus to their AC.

name: Senses
text: Svirfneblin have darkvision 120 feet and lowlight vision.

name: Fortunate
text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on all saving throws.

name: Skilled
text: Svirfneblin gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks; this improves to a +4 bonus underground. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks and Perception checks.

name: Hatred
text: Svirfneblin receive a +1 bonus on attack rolls against humanoid creatures of the reptilian and dwarf subtypes due to training against these hated foes.

name: Stonecunning
text: Svirfneblin gain the stonecunning trait as dwarves.

name: Spell Resistance
text: A svirfneblin has an amount of spell resistance equal to 11 + his character level.

name: Svirfneblin Magic
text: Svirfneblin add 1 to the DCs of any saving throws to resist illusion spells they cast. Svirfneblin also gain the following spell-like abilities: constant—nondetection; 1/day—blindness/deafness (DC 12 + Charisma modifier), blur, disguise self; caster level equals the svirfneblin’s character level.

name: Languages
text: Svirfneblin begin play speaking Gnome and Undercommon. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Common, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Giant, Goblin, Orc, and Terran.

text: Sylphs have electricity resistance 5.

name: Air Affinity
text: Sylph sorcerers with the elemental (air) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Sylph spellcasters with the Air domain use their domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

name: Languages
text: Sylphs speak Common and Auran. Sylphs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aquan, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, Ignan, and Terran.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Constitution: Tengus are fast and observant, but relatively fragile.

name: Tengu
text: Tengus are humanoids with the tengu subtype.

name: Medium
text: Tengus are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Tengus have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Senses
text: Tengus have low-light vision.

name: Sneaky
text: Tengus gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.

name: Gifted Linguist
text: Tengus gain a +4 racial bonus on Linguistics checks, and learn two languages each time they gain a rank in Linguistics rather than one language.

name: Swordtrained
text: Tengus are automatically proficient with swordlike weapons (including bastard swords, daggers, elven curve blades, falchions, greatswords, kukris, longswords, punching daggers, rapiers, scimitars, short swords, and two-bladed swords).

name: Natural Weapon
text: A tengu has a bite attack that deals 1d3 points of damage.

name: Languages
text: Tengus begin play speaking Common and Tengu. Tengus with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want (except for secret languages, such as Druidic).

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, –2 Charisma: Tieflings are quick in body and mind, but are inherently unnerving. Tieflings of specific bloodlines (see below) gain different ability score modifiers as indicated.

name: Native Outsider
text: Tieflings are outsiders with the native subtype.

name: Medium
text: Tieflings are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Tieflings have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Tieflings see in the dark for up to 60 feet.

name: Skilled
text: Tieflings gain a +2 racial bonus on Bluff and Stealth checks. Tieflings of specific bloodlines (see below) gain a +2 bonus on different skill checks as indicated.

name: Spell-Like Ability
text: Tieflings can use darkness once per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the tiefling’s character level). Tieflings of specific bloodlines (see below) gain different spell-like abilities.

name: Fiendish Resistance
text: Tieflings have cold resistance 5, electricity resistance 5, and fire resistance 5.

name: Fiendish Sorcery
text: Tiefling sorcerers with the Abyssal or Infernal bloodlines treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer class abilities.

name: Languages
text: Tieflings begin play speaking Common and either Abyssal or Infernal. Tieflings with high intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Abyssal, Draconic, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, Halfling, Infernal, and Orc.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Strength: Undines are perceptive and agile, but somewhat weak.

name: Native Outsider
text: Undines are outsiders with the native subtype.

name: Medium
text: Undines are Medium creatures and receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Undines have a base speed of 30 feet on land. They also have a swim speed of 30 feet, can move in water without needing to attempt Swim checks, and always treat Swim as a class skill.

name: Darkvision
text: Undines can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Spell-Like Ability
text: Undines can cast hydraulic push once per day as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to the undine’s character level).

name: Energy Resistance
text: Undines have cold resistance 5.

name: Water Affinity
text: Undine sorcerers with the elemental (water) bloodline treat their Charisma scores as 2 points higher for the purposes of all sorcerer spells and class abilities. Undine clerics with the Water domain cast their Water domain powers and spells at +1 caster level.

name: Languages
text: Undines begin play speaking Common and Aquan. Undines with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Auran, Dwarven, Elven, Gnome, Halfling, Ignan, and Terran.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, –2 Charisma: Vanaras are agile and perceptive, but are also rather impish and mischievous.

name: Vanara
text: Vanaras are humanoids with the vanara subtype.

name: Medium
text: Vanaras are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Vanaras have a base speed of 30 feet and a Climb speed of 20 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: A vanara can see twice as far as a human in dim light.

name: Nimble
text: Vanaras have a +2 racial bonus on Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

name: Prehensile Tail
text: A vanara has a long, flexible tail that she can use to carry objects. She cannot wield weapons with her tail, but the tail allows her to retrieve a small, stowed object carried on her person as a swift action.

name: Languages
text: Vanaras begin play speaking Common and Vanaran. Vanaras with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Celestial, Elven, Gnome, Goblin, and Sylvan.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, –2 Wisdom: Vishkanyas are graceful but often irrational.

name: Vishkanya
text: Vishkanyas are humanoids with the vishkanya subtype.

name: Medium
text: Vishkanyas are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.

name: Normal Speed
text: Vishkanyas have a base speed of 30 feet.

name: Low-Light Vision
text: Vishkanyas can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.

name: Keen Senses
text: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

name: Limber
text: Vishkanyas receive a +2 racial bonus on Escape Artist and Stealth checks.

name: Poison Resistance
text: A vishkanya has a racial bonus on saving throws against poison equal to its Hit Dice.

name: Poison Use
text: Vishkanyas are skilled in the use of poison and never accidentally poison themselves when using or applying poison.

name: Toxic
text: A number of times per day equal to his Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day), a vishkanya can envenom a weapon that he wields with his toxic saliva or blood (using blood requires the vishkanya to be injured when he uses this ability). Applying venom in this way is a swift action.

name: Weapon Familiarity
text: Vishkanyas are always proficient with blowguns, kukri, and shuriken.

name: Languages
text: Vishkanyas begin play speaking Common and Vishkanya. Vishkanyas with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Aklo, Draconic, Elven, Goblin, Sylvan, and Undercommon.

name: Ability Score Modifiers
text: +2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, –2 Wisdom: Wayangs are nimble and cagey, but their perception of the world is clouded by shadows.

name: Wayang
text: Wayangs are humanoids with the wayang subtype.

name: Small
text: Wayangs are Small creatures and gain a +1 size bonus to their AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a –1 penalty on combat maneuver checks and to their Combat Maneuver Defense, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.

name: Slow Speed
text: Wayangs have a base speed of 20 feet.

name: Darkvision
text: Wayangs can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

name: Light and Dark
text: Once per day as an immediate action, a wayang can treat positive and negative energy effects as if she were an undead creature, taking damage from positive energy and being healed of damage by negative energy. This ability lasts for 1 minute once activated.

name: Lurker
text: Wayangs gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception and Stealth checks.

name: Shadow Magic
text: Wayangs add 1 to the DC of any saving throws to resist spells of the shadow subschool that they cast. Wayangs with a Charisma score of 11 or higher also gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day—ghost sound, pass without trace, and ventriloquism. The caster level for these effects is equal to the wayang’s character level. The DCs of these spells are equal to 10 + the spell’s level + the wayang’s Charisma modifier.

name: Shadow Resistance
text: Wayangs get a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells of the shadow subschool.

name: Languages
text: Wayangs begin play speaking Common and Wayang. Wayangs with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: any human language, Abyssal, Aklo, Draconic, Goblin, Infernal, Nagaji, Samsaran, and Tengu.
